nodes.label: GUI Bundled Version Identity
nodes.rationale: Uses the install-immutable bundled YAML version so a per-user data update cannot make the executable appear newer and suppress a real upgrade notification.

nodes.label: Portable Qt Deployment
nodes.rationale: Runs windeployqt inside the install prefix and places plugins and translations under Qt6 while preserving a portable root-level executable layout.

nodes.label: Explicit vcpkg Qt Runtime DLL Set
nodes.norm_label: explicit vcpkg qt runtime dll set

nodes.label: Headless Qt Test Harness
nodes.rationale: Selects offscreen or minimal Qt platform plugins and supplies their paths so GUI tests can run without an interactive display.

nodes.label: SIL Open Font License 1.1
nodes.rationale: Provides a free and open framework for collaborative font development, sharing, and improvement.

nodes.label: Inter v4.1 Bundled Typeface
nodes.rationale: Bundling Inter keeps text rendering consistent across Windows 10 and Windows 11 regardless of installed system fonts.

nodes.label: Qt Resource License Propagation
nodes.rationale: Ships and embeds the unmodified license so distributed GUI builds satisfy the OFL license-propagation requirement.
